block-no-record: We have not read your record yet. We just asked Wargaming for it, so try again in a moment.

too-few-battles: Your account has {played} battles. We ask for {required} before a vote on {map} counts, which is about twenty passages through each map in the rotation, so that a verdict comes from someone who has actually been here.
